# Recorded coingecko responses

Replayed by the Market tests (`tests/unit/test_market_*.py`); no credentials (keyless public API).

- `coins.json`: api.coingecko.com/api/v3 `coins/markets` page 1 (trimmed to the 5 largest coins), `coins/bitcoin/market_chart` (365 days, daily) and `coins/bitcoin` (categories).
